text:
jenna-release: Heads up — deploy-bot flagged something on the v2.3.1 release notes flow, SBOM shows a dependency with an ambiguous license. Blocking the release notes until we decide.

deploy-bot: automated scan result:
```
SBOM scan v1.4.2
package: epoch-lib@0.8.3
license: UNKNOWN
source: https://registry.example.com/epoch-lib-0.8.3.tgz
provenance: missing-signature
vulns: none detected
```

maria-dev: ack. Is epoch-lib actually used at runtime? IIRC it's pulled in by the docs generator only.

devon-security: quick check: it's imported under `docs/` but shows up in the SBOM because we bundle the build container. We treat UNKNOWN as a high-compliance signal for release (per policy). Need legal signoff or remove from artifact.

jenna-release: legal-ops, ping — can we get an exception for a docs-only transitive dep? We need a decision before tomorrow morning change window.

legal-ops: @jenna-release @devon-security please share the SBOM link and confirm whether epoch-lib is included in production images. If it's only in build-time/CI images we can consider scoped exception and mitigation (audit trail + pin).

ci-bot: build artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/7423/sbom.json (epoch-lib appears in "build-system" BOM, not runtime).

maria-dev: confirmed — not in runtime images. It's pulled by `mkdocs` plugin we use for release notes generation. We can regenerate docs in a container that excludes it, or vendor the small patched script. Work estimate: ~2 hrs to vendor; ~30m to rebuild docs and verify.

devon-security: options:
- remove/vendor (preferred) — no policy exception needed
- temporary legal exception scoped to this release + create Jira to remediate within 72h
- block release until vendor/patch completes
Which do we want?

jenna-release: Our change window is tight. If vendoring takes 2 hrs, we can either delay the release by 2 hours or take the legal scoped exception and proceed. What does legal recommend?

legal-ops: Scope exception ok if risk is low and the dep isn't in prod. Conditions: documented approval in thread, Jira created (SEC-xxxx) with remediation deadline (72h), and SBOM entry annotated. We also need a signed attestation from the engineering owner.

maria-dev: I can vendor the package this afternoon but will need deployment to wait until the rebuild completes. If we take exception, my team will still vendor and file the Jira. Preference: take exception so release isn't delayed, we still remediate within 48h.

devon-security: I'm fine with scoped exception provided remediation steps are tracked and CI is updated to exclude build-time deps from release SBOM next sprint. Please create Jira and tag me.

jenna-release: Decision: scoped legal exception granted per legal-ops checklist. Actions:
- maria-dev: create SEC-4210 (remediate vendor or exclude) and attach rebuild artifacts (due in 48h)
- maria-dev: rebuild docs with vendored epoch-lib and push new SBOM
- devon-security: verify updated SBOM and close security check
- jenna-release: proceed with release notes publish and canary rollout, disable automatic SBOM gate for build-system BOM only for this run (:warning: documented)

maria-dev: creating SEC-4210 now. I'll post the Jira link and ETA in this thread when done.

ci-bot: noted. Temporary gate override set by release lead for this thread: reason="docs-only build dep, legal exception SEC-4210"

jenna-release: thanks all — please update the release notes with a short line: "Documentation build dependency exception: epoch-lib (SBOM entry UNKNOWN) — remediation in progress (SEC-4210)." We'll include this in the change log. :white_check_mark:
